senses.gloss:
इज्य pot. p. (of यज्) To be
worshipped.
--ज्यः
1 A teacher.
--2
An epithet of बृहस्पति, the teacher
of the gods.
--3 The Puṣya
Nakṣatra.
--4 The Supreme being.
--5
An epithet of Viṣṇu.
--ज्या
1 A
sacrifice; जगत्प्रकाशं तदशेषमिज्यया
R. 3. 48, 1. 68, 15. 2; Bg. 11. 53, 9. 25.
--2 A gift, donation.
--3 An image.
--4 Worship, reverence.
--5 Meeting,
union.
--6 A bawd or procuress.
--7 A cow.
--Comp.
--शीलः a
constant sacrificer.
